cohort: The study included 160 term neonates with perinatal asphyxia in District Mardan, Pakistan.
finding: The prevalence of HIE was 10% in the perinatal asphyxia population, and there was an association between HIE and weight groups, but not with sex, age groups, gestational age, or mode of delivery.
mod_finding: There was no association found between the presence of HIE and mode of delivery.
birth_weight: Mean weight 3.275+-0.36 kg, categorized into <=3 kg and >3 kg groups.
gest_age: Mean gestational age 38.681+-1.24 weeks, categorized into 37-39 weeks and >39 weeks.
